expectations.text: The guide names the receiving location and enters 6000 grams and $0.012 per gram, with cost per stock unit distinguished from total sack cost.
expectations.evidence: Opens Items > Flour > Receive existing stock; enters Quantity 6000 and Cost (per stock unit) 0.012, explicitly $72 / 6000 grams = $0.012 per gram and warns against entering $72 total.

expectations.text: The check has observable fields and expected values, with correction before Post and a warning that blank cost becomes zero.
expectations.evidence: Step 4 checks Quantity 6000 and Cost 0.012 and permits direct correction before Post; step 3 warns blank cost is stored as zero.

expectations.text: After posting, it uses the History receipt ID and inventory lead for audited correction; it invents neither an undo nor a cost-unit selector.
expectations.evidence: History location and receipt row fields are explicit; posted errors go to inventory lead with receipt ID for audited correction. States no edit/undo and no cost-unit selector.
